title: Adopt product proving-ground passports for vaporware products
createdBy: codex after chairman connected vaporware product proof to automotive proving grounds

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-07-05: chairman asked to evolve proving grounds so every vaporware product carries the same kind of proof discipline car designers use.
historicalContent.description: Create the first typed product proving-ground passport for vaporware products. Each product class should know expected tracks, each product profile should name owning bead, CUJs, scenarios, targetable tests, receipts, and release-doctor checks, and release review should be able to reject incomplete passports.
acceptanceCriteria: FR-033 defines product proving-ground passports in the PRD.
CUJ-23 defines the product proving-ground adoption journey and proof boundary.
GATE-40 records the product proving-ground release gate.
VaporizeTestSupport defines a product proving-ground profile, scenario, and adoption audit.

VaporizeCUJ23ProductProvingGroundTests proves a passing Vaporize CLI passport, missing-track failure, missing-receipt failure, missing-targetable-test failure, and product-class default track catalog.
vaporize.engineering.docc/product-proving-grounds.md documents tracks, class defaults, release rule, and boundaries.
Release Doctor checks FR-033, CUJ-23, GATE-40, the engineering doc, launch-review reference, and CUJ-23 coverage.
